name: Peanut Curry Beans on Toast
steps: Tip the butter beans and peanut curry sauce into a small saucepan and set it over a medium heat. Let everything warm through, stirring occasionally.
Meanwhile, toast the sourdough. Pick the coriander leaves and finely slice the stems. Thinly slice the spring onion.
Once the beans are piping hot, give them a taste and season with salt and black pepper, if needed.
Plate up the toast, spoon over the warm beans and finish with coriander and spring onion. Drizzle over a little olive oil, if you fancy.
